description: This file contains Python decorators and classes for registering schema pre-processing and post-processing methods in the marshmallow serialization/deserialization library. It defines various decorator functions such as validates, validates_schema, pre_dump, post_dump, pre_load, and post_load, along with a helper function set_hook, and a class MarshmallowHook. The decorators are used to annotate methods for schema validation and data transformation.

classes.name: MarshmallowHook
classes.description: A class that holds a dictionary for marshmallow hook configurations, used internally for registering hooks.

methods.name: validates
methods.description: Decorator to register a validator method for specific fields.

methods.name: validates_schema
methods.description: Decorator to register a schema-level validator method.

methods.name: pre_dump
methods.description: Decorator to register a method to invoke before serializing an object.

methods.name: post_dump
methods.description: Decorator to register a method to invoke after serializing an object.

methods.name: pre_load
methods.description: Decorator to register a method to invoke before deserializing an object.

methods.name: post_load
methods.description: Decorator to register a method to invoke after deserializing an object.

methods.name: set_hook
methods.description: Internal function to mark a function as a hook for marshmallow processing.
